name: The Wind from Rixcall
source:
Main character has a mysterious ability to hear voices of spirits. One day a person wearing Greek mythical costume approaches and attacks him. Mysterious events start to happen around him. To get to the source of all mysteries he needs to go to the world "Rixcor". 

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/07/vn-of-month-december-2003-saya-no-uta.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公拥有听见灵魂声音的神秘能力。一天，一名身穿希腊神话风格服装的人靠近并袭击了他，随后怪事接连在身边发生。为了抵达所有谜团的源头，他必须前往名为“Rixcor”的世界。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/07/vn-of-month-december-2003-saya-no-uta.html]vndbreview[/url]]
